The audit script failed due to a data type mismatch between datetime objects and strings in the 'Formatted Data' worksheet.
The test_formatted_data_logic in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with an AssertionError at index 4. The output worksheet contained datetime.datetime(2026, 3, 1, 0, 0) objects, whereas the verifier expected string representations like '2026-03-01'. Ensure openpyxl or the processing logic explicitly formats date columns as strings to match the expected BASE_HEADERS schema.
